name: Antigravity CLI
stdin: Read the file {systemPromptPath} completely. It holds your instructions. Then read the file {userPromptPath} and carry out the task it describes. Write files only inside {artifactDirAbs}.
limits: The Antigravity CLI could edit any file of the workspace. Codjiva checks the workspace after every run and discards the result if a file outside its own folder was changed.
installHint: Install the Antigravity CLI from https://antigravity.google, then run `agy` once in a terminal to sign in.
loginHint: Run `agy` once in a terminal and sign in.
